tagline: Selected text → a ready AI prompt

slides.title: Turn any selection into a ready AI prompt
slides.text: Select text, press Alt+P or right-click → Pastebot, pick what you want done.

slides.title: The prompt is already in your clipboard
slides.text: Paste it into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor or any AI tool you use.

slides.title: Edit before you copy
slides.text: The toolbar popup takes the page selection or pasted text, lets you pick the action and tweak the prompt.

slides.title: Your own prompt templates
slides.text: Write an instruction once. It appears in the right-click menu, the panel and the popup.

slides.title: Search and pin past prompts
slides.text: Up to 500 prompts, kept only in your browser. No account, no server, no analytics.
